guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low (reset), async_fault_q is cleared to zero.
On every positive edge of clk_i when rst_ni is high, async_fault_q takes the value of async_fault_o.

uncertain_points.claim: If async_fault_o is asynchronous to clk_i, the single-flop sampling may capture a metastable value, leading to incorrect async_fault_q state.
uncertain_points.cond: async_fault_o changes near posedge clk_i while rst_ni is high
uncertain_points.risk: Fault indication could be spuriously asserted or missed, potentially affecting error handling or security response.
